plate.title: The Hall of Mirrors
plate.sub: the nerves and threads of the Hollow Mystic

notables.name: The Loom Behind the Eyes
notables.lore: The Weaver does not see. It is seen through.

notables.name: The Lantern's Patience
notables.lore: A little longer. A little longer. Every wick says this.

notables.name: The Unraveller
notables.lore: Every thread is cut in the end. Some of them are cut by you.

notables.name: Quicksilver Tongue
notables.lore: The prayer is shorter if you leave out the parts that beg.

notables.name: The Wisps Return
notables.lore: They always come back to the hand that let them go.

notables.name: The Thread in the Spine
notables.lore: Pull it, and the whole body answers.

notables.name: The Long Nerve
notables.lore: Pain takes the longest road in the body. So does news.

w_ani_root.name: The Hall of Mirrors: the gate

w_ani_6.name: The Thread in the Spine
w_ani_6.lore: Pull it, and the whole body answers.

w_ani_39.name: Quicksilver Tongue
w_ani_39.lore: The prayer is shorter if you leave out the parts that beg.

w_ani_43.name: The Wisps Return
w_ani_43.lore: They always come back to the hand that let them go.

w_ani_67.name: The Long Nerve
w_ani_67.lore: Pain takes the longest road in the body. So does news.

w_ani_98.name: The Loom Behind the Eyes
w_ani_98.lore: The Weaver does not see. It is seen through.

w_ani_102.name: The Lantern's Patience
w_ani_102.lore: A little longer. A little longer. Every wick says this.

w_ani_106.name: The Unraveller
w_ani_106.lore: Every thread is cut in the end. Some of them are cut by you.

w_ani_circ0_n.name: The Rebuke Sung Upward
w_ani_circ0_n.lore: He answered the choir with a blade. The choir sang it back to him, sharper.

w_ani_circ1_n.name: The Bell Over the Anvil
w_ani_circ1_n.lore: Strike the one, and the other answers. Nobody taught them this.

w_ani_circ2_n.name: The Thread Let Down
w_ani_circ2_n.lore: A thread runs from the hand that holds the anvil to the foot that walks away from it.

w_ani_circ3_n.name: Between Two Footfalls
w_ani_circ3_n.lore: The dead walk in step. He walks between their steps, where no one is counting.

w_ani_circ4_n.name: The Hungry Thread
w_ani_circ4_n.lore: It pulls toward the blade. It always pulls toward the blade.

notables.name: The Crown of the Standing
notables.lore: The skull is the last bone to lie down. His never will.

notables.name: The Kept Wall
notables.lore: The ribs were a vault before they were a crypt.

notables.name: The Elbow That Does Not Bend
notables.lore: A joint is a place where bone agrees to give. His agree to nothing.

notables.name: Marrow Patience
notables.lore: The duelists in the dark still go through their forms. They are in no hurry.

notables.name: The Kneeling Refused
notables.lore: Old Upright never knelt. Neither will you.

notables.name: Heavy Tread
notables.lore: The dust keeps his footprints longer than it should.

notables.name: The Holy Bone
notables.lore: Os sacrum. The oldest priests buried it last, because it was the last to be given back.

w_oss_3.name: The Kept Wall
w_oss_3.lore: The ribs were a vault before they were a crypt.

w_oss_12.name: The Crown of the Standing
w_oss_12.lore: The skull is the last bone to lie down. His never will.

w_oss_39.name: The Elbow That Does Not Bend
w_oss_39.lore: A joint is a place where bone agrees to give. His agree to nothing.

w_oss_43.name: Marrow Patience
w_oss_43.lore: The duelists in the dark still go through their forms. They are in no hurry.

w_oss_62.name: The Holy Bone
w_oss_62.lore: Os sacrum. The oldest priests buried it last, because it was the last to be given back.

w_oss_74.name: The Kneeling Refused
w_oss_74.lore: Old Upright never knelt. Neither will you.

w_oss_79.name: Heavy Tread
w_oss_79.lore: The dust keeps his footprints longer than it should.

w_oss_circ0_n.name: The Chanted Arc
w_oss_circ0_n.lore: The grave-chant goes round the skull and comes back as a spear.

w_oss_circ1_n.name: The Crown Weighed
w_oss_circ1_n.lore: A crown is only a ring of bone that learned to be heavy.

w_oss_circ2_n.name: The Long Bone
w_oss_circ2_n.lore: From the hand to the heel is one bone, if you count the way the Chapter counts.

w_oss_circ3_n.name: The Pilgrim's Count
w_oss_circ3_n.lore: Two hundred and six. He counts them walking, one to each step.

w_oss_circ4_n.name: The Kin Road
w_oss_circ4_n.lore: What the blood leaves on the bone, the bone keeps.

notables.name: The Red Tithe
notables.lore: The Maiden takes her tenth. She leaves you the rest, warm.

notables.name: Open Veins
notables.lore: A wound that never scabbed is a well that never dries.

notables.name: The Wrist Offered
notables.lore: The brotherhoods cut here first. It is the easiest place to ask.

notables.name: Blood to the Temple
notables.lore: Every thought is carried on something red.

notables.name: The Fork of the River
notables.lore: Where the great vessel parts, the fen-folk say, a child is always listening.

notables.name: The Kneeling Pulse
notables.lore: Kneel, and you can hear it behind the knee.

notables.name: Thin Blood
notables.lore: It runs faster. It runs out faster.

w_hem_3.name: Blood to the Temple
w_hem_3.lore: Every thought is carried on something red.

w_hem_13.name: The Red Tithe
w_hem_13.lore: The Maiden takes her tenth. She leaves you the rest, warm.

w_hem_28.name: Open Veins
w_hem_28.lore: A wound that never scabbed is a well that never dries.

w_hem_32.name: The Wrist Offered
w_hem_32.lore: The brotherhoods cut here first. It is the easiest place to ask.

w_hem_50.name: The Fork of the River
w_hem_50.lore: Where the great vessel parts, the fen-folk say, a child is always listening.

w_hem_57.name: The Kneeling Pulse
w_hem_57.lore: Kneel, and you can hear it behind the knee.

w_hem_64.name: Thin Blood
w_hem_64.lore: It runs faster. It runs out faster.

w_hem_circ0_n.name: The Red Arc
w_hem_circ0_n.lore: The heart throws the blood upward. Some of it never comes down.

w_hem_circ1_n.name: The Crown of Veins
w_hem_circ1_n.lore: The Maiden wears her veins outside. She says it is cooler.

w_hem_circ2_n.name: The Long Vein
w_hem_circ2_n.lore: It runs from the clutching hand to the sole, and it is warm the whole way.

w_hem_circ3_n.name: The Tithe Walked
w_hem_circ3_n.lore: She walks the tithe to the altar on her own feet. She arrives lighter.

w_hem_circ4_n.name: The Marrow-Kin Vein
w_hem_circ4_n.lore: Blood set in bone. Bone set in blood. Neither will say which came first.

plate.title: The Well-Shrine
plate.sub: the breath of the Shrine Keeper

notables.name: The Last Breath
notables.lore: The god died breathing out, and never finished. She finishes it for him, a little at a time.

notables.name: The Held Breath
notables.lore: She did not breathe out. She is still looking for someone who will.

notables.name: The Fan Unfolded
notables.lore: The breath goes where the fan tells it to.

notables.name: Salt on the Threshold
notables.lore: The guardian stone at the torii faces the wrong way. She turns it back each time she passes.

notables.name: Grandmother Wind
notables.lore: She carries the small gods home on her back.

notables.name: The Undertow
notables.lore: What is breathed in must go somewhere. It goes down.

notables.name: The Mouth of the Well
notables.lore: The Well-Shrine was dug where a drowned child first breathed out.

w_shr_1.name: The Mouth of the Well
w_shr_1.lore: The Well-Shrine was dug where a drowned child first breathed out.

w_shr_9.name: The Last Breath
w_shr_9.lore: The god died breathing out, and never finished. She finishes it for him, a little at a time.

w_shr_53.name: The Fan Unfolded
w_shr_53.lore: The breath goes where the fan tells it to.

w_shr_55.name: Salt on the Threshold
w_shr_55.lore: The guardian stone at the torii faces the wrong way. She turns it back each time she passes.

w_shr_63.name: The Held Breath
w_shr_63.lore: She did not breathe out. She is still looking for someone who will.

w_shr_72.name: Grandmother Wind
w_shr_72.lore: She carries the small gods home on her back.

w_shr_95.name: The Undertow
w_shr_95.lore: What is breathed in must go somewhere. It goes down.

w_shr_circ0_n.name: The Omen Carried Up
w_shr_circ0_n.lore: The omens rise with the smoke. The Reaper reads them from underneath.

w_shr_circ1_n.name: The Mirror Breathed On
w_shr_circ1_n.lore: Breathe on the glass and the Hanged Man writes a name in it.

w_shr_circ2_n.name: The Breath Let Go
w_shr_circ2_n.lore: What the fan sends out, the feet walk through after.

w_shr_circ3_n.name: The Two Winds Meet
w_shr_circ3_n.lore: One wind for the widow, one for the veil. They meet at the ankle and argue.

w_shr_circ4_n.name: The Widow's Sigh
w_shr_circ4_n.lore: She breathes out for him still. It has not reached him yet.

plate.title: The Black-Flame Road
plate.sub: the channels of the Empty Hand

notables.name: The Hundred Meetings
notables.lore: The glass remembers his laugh by day. By night it remembers what he laughed at.

notables.name: The Sea of Breath
notables.lore: The middle dantian. Fill it, and nothing knocks you over.

notables.name: Lantern in the Fist
notables.lore: His black-flame lantern reads brighter the deeper he walks.

notables.name: The Empty Laugh
notables.lore: Ha. Once. It is enough.

notables.name: The Bubbling Spring
notables.lore: The first point of the kidney channel is in the sole. He walks barefoot so it can drink.

notables.name: The Barefoot Gate
notables.lore: Stone is honest to a bare foot.

notables.name: Three Leagues More
notables.lore: The point below the knee that gives a tired walker three leagues more.

w_kus_3.name: The Sea of Breath
w_kus_3.lore: The middle dantian. Fill it, and nothing knocks you over.

w_kus_11.name: The Hundred Meetings
w_kus_11.lore: The glass remembers his laugh by day. By night it remembers what he laughed at.

w_kus_30.name: Lantern in the Fist
w_kus_30.lore: His black-flame lantern reads brighter the deeper he walks.

w_kus_72.name: Three Leagues More
w_kus_72.lore: The point below the knee that gives a tired walker three leagues more.

w_kus_102.name: The Bubbling Spring
w_kus_102.lore: The first point of the kidney channel is in the sole. He walks barefoot so it can drink.

w_kus_114.name: The Barefoot Gate
w_kus_114.lore: Stone is honest to a bare foot.

w_kus_circ0_n.name: The Noon Arc
w_kus_circ0_n.lore: At noon the glass remembers everything at once.

w_kus_circ1_n.name: The Hundred Roads
w_kus_circ1_n.lore: All the channels meet at the crown and argue about which way is down.

w_kus_circ2_n.name: The Palm to the Sole
w_kus_circ2_n.lore: The strike begins in the heel. He only lets it out through the palm.

w_kus_circ3_n.name: The Walking Meditation
w_kus_circ3_n.lore: Left foot: the laugh. Right foot: what he laughed at.

w_kus_circ4_n.name: The Black Channel
w_kus_circ4_n.lore: The yin channel runs up the leg, through the empty hand, and out.

o_pyredead.name: The Pyre-Dead
o_pyredead.up: Your skeletons are truly on fire: they run faster, hunt anything in sight, strike faster and burn everything next to them, but the fire eats them fast (6% of their life a second) and they crumble; their bone returns to your aura.
o_pyredead.rev: Skeletons don't burn while they stand. When they fall they burst into fire and leave the ground burning.

o_bowyer.name: The Bowyer
o_bowyer.up: Squads can take the Bow loadout: archers shoot from range.
o_bowyer.rev: Squads can take the Bow loadout, and archers become harpooners: their shots hook enemies and drag them toward your melee skeletons.

o_chanter.name: The Grave-Chanter
o_chanter.up: Squads can take the Mage loadout: skeleton mages cast a small copy of the last Marrow spell you cast.
o_chanter.rev: Squads can take the Mage loadout, but mages don't fight. They chant the bone out of the earth: each one near you adds 50% to your aura's pull.

o_oath.name: The Oathbound
o_oath.up: Skeletons hold a line: they never stray more than 4 yd from you and take 30% less damage.
o_oath.rev: Skeletons ignore their orders and hunt anything within 12 yd. Each kill makes them all faster for 5 s (up to 5 times).

o_shove.name: Shoving Dead
o_shove.up: Skeleton melee hits shove enemies back a step.

o_rise.name: Grave Rise
o_rise.up: A skeleton clawing out of the ground cuts everything around it.

o_return.name: Bone Returns
o_return.up: A fallen skeleton sends 2 shards straight back to your aura.

o_stride.name: Colossal Stride
o_stride.up: The Colossus shoves enemies aside as it walks, staggering them.

o_herald.name: Heralds of Bone
o_herald.up: While you direct the Colossus, your skeletons move 25% faster.

o_rattle.name: The Rattle
o_rattle.up: A skeleton rising from the ground taunts enemies within 3 yd for 2 s.

o_tower.name: The Tower
o_tower.up: Bone Spear splits into 3 splinters on the first enemy it hits.
o_tower.rev: Melee: Bone Spear becomes a thrust from your hand that hits everything in a 3 yd line at once, for half the cost.

o_cage.name: The Cage-Warden
o_cage.up: Rib Cage springs a cage around each of up to 3 enemies near the cursor.
o_cage.rev: Rib Cage closes around you instead: while it lasts you take 35% less damage and anything that hits you is thrown back and cut.

o_grasp.name: The Grasping Earth
o_grasp.up: Charnel Cage grips: the first enemy its arms catch is held in place for 1.5 s.
o_grasp.rev: Melee: for as long as the arms would last, bone arms erupt around your feet as you walk instead of in a line.

o_rime.name: Rime
o_rime.up: Bone Spikes and Shard Storm chill. Frozen enemies that die shatter into shards for your aura.
o_rime.rev: Your shard aura chills anything that strikes you in melee, but your spells don't chill.

m_caltrop.name: Caltrops
m_caltrop.up: Bone Spear leaves a caltrop where it stops. It cuts and slows for 3 s.

m_return.name: Boomerang Bone
m_return.up: Bone Spear flies back to you when its flight ends, cutting again on the way.

m_hooks.name: Rib Hooks
m_hooks.up: Rib Cage drags the enemies inside it toward its center.

m_echo.name: Spike Echo
m_echo.up: Bone Spikes erupt a second time 0.6 s later at half damage.

m_scatter.name: Scatter
m_scatter.up: Shard Storm shards that fall to the ground can be pulled back into your aura.

m_tread.name: Marrow Tread
m_tread.up: Charnel Cage's arms knock enemies off their feet as they rise.

o_reliq.name: The Reliquary
o_reliq.up: While you wear the Bone Host, missiles that strike you are thrown back as bone.
o_reliq.rev: Ranged: wearing the Bone Host roots you in place as a bone turret. It fires the carapace at the nearest enemy as shards.

o_maelstrom.name: The Maelstrom
o_maelstrom.up: The shard aura spins wide and slow, cutting everything within 3 yd.
o_maelstrom.rev: Ranged: every attack you make also flings a shard from your aura at the target, but the aura no longer turns blows aside.

c_trail.name: Shard Trail
c_trail.up: Dodge rolls leave a trail of shards that cut enemies crossing them.

c_crash.name: Crash
c_crash.up: Grinding Charge ends in a shockwave.

c_spines.name: Carapace Spines
c_spines.up: When your Bone Host carapace cracks, its shards burst outward and cut.

c_grind.name: Grinding Pull
c_grind.up: Shards your aura pulls through enemies slow them.

c_throw.name: Thrown Shard
c_throw.up: Every fourth weapon hit throws a shard in a straight line.

o_marrowkin.name: The Marrow-Kin
o_marrowkin.up: Blood from your kills hardens into bone: a third of them burst into spikes.

o_revenant.name: The Revenant
o_revenant.up: A fallen skeleton rises as a spirit for 5 s and keeps fighting.

h_graft.name: The Graft-Father
h_graft.up: Three little hoods that touch fuse into a chimera: bigger, slower, with a bigger strike and burst.
h_graft.rev: Up to 4 little hoods ride on your body instead of walking. Your weapon hits get their blows, and Fevered Charge flings them off at the enemy.

h_clutch.name: The Clutch
h_clutch.up: Tumors that land without hitting anything lie in wait and give up into a clutch when an enemy walks close. Every tumor is a trap.
h_clutch.rev: Your tumors are fat and slow: each bursts harder and wider, into three little hoods.

h_giant.name: The Hollow Giant
h_giant.up: When the Sewn Martyr drops below half life it tears off a Lesser Martyr, a half-size Martyr that fights for 20 s.
h_giant.rev: Melee: you wear the Martyr. You are huge, slow and hit hard, it soaks most blows, and your procession gives up from your body.

h_pyre.name: Pyre
h_pyre.up: Little hoods burn: their blows set enemies on fire, and they die in a burst of flame.

b_twin.name: Twin Birth
b_twin.up: Each corpse you give up has a 35% chance to give one more little hood.

b_wall.name: Tumor Wall
b_wall.up: Tumors lying on the ground stop enemy missiles.

b_throes.name: Death Throes
b_throes.up: A little hood that dies blows everything next to it.

b_glut.name: Glut
b_glut.up: The Sewn Martyr eats twice as fast and heals 10% more from each meal.

b_lurch.name: Quivering Oozes
b_lurch.up: Blood Oozes move 40% faster and spit twice as often.

h_tide.name: The Crimson Tide
h_tide.up: Blood Vomit gouts often split into three after the first body they soak through.
h_tide.rev: Melee: a sword of blood sweeps an arc in front of you and leaves a pool.

h_leech.name: The Tithe-Drinker
h_leech.up: Root Veins drain 2% of your life for every enemy they strike.
h_leech.rev: Ranged: the veins shoot out as a hooked tendril up to 7 yd and drag the first enemy to you.

h_blight.name: The Blood-Queen
h_blight.up: Bleeding spreads: every 2 s a bleeding enemy passes its bleed to its nearest neighbor.
h_blight.rev: Bleeding doesn't tick. It gathers, and bursts all at once for 150% when it ends.

h_rime.name: Rime
h_rime.up: Blood freezes: bleeding enemies are chilled, and a long bleed freezes them solid.
h_rime.rev: Blood pools freeze into ice. Enemies that step on them slip and can't act for 1 s.

l_drag.name: Undertow
l_drag.up: Hemorrhage drags the enemies around its target in toward it.

l_sympathy.name: Sympathetic Burst
l_sympathy.up: Corpse Burst makes everything it hits bleed.

l_clot.name: Clotting
l_clot.up: Blood Vomit splashes root what they hit for 0.6 s.

l_lash.name: Deep Lash
l_lash.up: Root Veins' bleeding lasts twice as long.

l_wind.name: Scent of Blood
l_wind.up: Blood Frenzy reaches twice as far.

h_glutton.name: The Glutton
h_glutton.up: Each Communion grows an extra penance you have learned but aren't wearing, for 10 s.
h_glutton.rev: Ranged: Communion doesn't feed you. You vomit what you ate as a cone of blood and gore at the cursor.

h_heart.name: The Bleeding Heart
h_heart.up: Above 80% Vitae, your skills cost no life at all.
h_heart.rev: Your skills take no Vitae, only raw life, and Vitae becomes a shield that soaks 70% of every blow.

f_gnash.name: Gnashing Maw
f_gnash.up: The Open Side blows also strike a second enemy next to the first.

f_shed.name: Shed Scar
f_shed.up: When you are struck, Cilice may tear loose a ridge of scar that cuts the attacker.

f_quick.name: Quick Meal
f_quick.up: Communion takes no time and gives 50% more Vitae.

f_gills.name: Deep Wounds
f_gills.up: Stigmata work up to 1 yd from a pool.

f_rain.name: Tumor Rain
f_rain.up: The Cross He Carries hoods burst 50% wider.

f_coil.name: Tightening Thorns
f_coil.up: The thorns hold what they catch for 1 s.

hk_marrow.name: The Marrow-Kin
hk_marrow.up: Little hoods grow bone plates: they take 30% less damage and burst into bone shards when they die.

hk_hunger.name: The Hungering Aether
hk_hunger.up: Your kills leave soul wisps that drift to you and refill 3% Vitae each.

a_anvil.name: The Anvil
a_anvil.up: Falling Mirror and the golem's blows leave splinters of glass on the ground for 4 s. Whatever walks through them is cut.
a_anvil.rev: Melee: the golem does not stand beside you; you wear it. Half of every blow you take is taken from its iron instead, and your weapon strikes 50% harder.

a_maiden.name: The Maiden's Kiss
a_maiden.up: The Hall of Mirrors also drags every creature within 3 yd into the cage.
a_maiden.rev: The Hall of Mirrors closes on you instead: while it stands, whatever strikes you in melee takes 60% of the blow back, and you walk 20% slower.

a_storm.name: Storm
a_storm.up: Every standing mirror sheds a splinter of glass at the nearest creature within 5 yd each second.
a_storm.rev: The Mirror Shield rebounds between everything it strikes: one more rebound for each creature it cuts, up to four.

i_quake.name: Aftershock
i_quake.up: Rising mirrors stagger twice as long.

i_rust.name: Tarnish
i_rust.up: Creatures next to your standing mirrors take 15% more damage.

i_rally.name: Rally
i_rally.up: When the golem rises from dormancy it mends 15% of your life.

i_spikes.name: Standing Shards
i_spikes.up: Mirror Fissure leaves one more mirror standing.

a_choir.name: The Choir
a_choir.up: Every 2 s the whole choir strikes together: every drifting revenant wisp dives at the same creature.
a_choir.rev: A revenant wisp that strikes a creature dives into it and holds it for 3 s: the held creature turns on its own kind.

a_bell.name: The Bell-Warden
a_bell.up: Every fifth spell rings a bell: creatures within 3.5 yd stagger for half a breath.
a_bell.rev: Creatures within 5 yd can't cast or shoot, and neither can you for 1 s after each spell.

a_lantern.name: The Lantern-Bearer
a_lantern.up: Your Soul Lantern walks with you instead of standing where you set it.
a_lantern.rev: Melee: you swing the Soul Lantern as a flail. Each blow splashes round the target, and every other blow frees a wisp.

w_ember.name: Long Flight
w_ember.up: Darting wisps' needles run 30% farther, and splitting wisps throw one more spark.

w_host.name: Great Host
w_host.up: The great wisp can hold 3 more wisps.

w_tether.name: Silver Tether
w_tether.up: While you stand within 3 yd of the golem, it mends 2% of its iron a second.

w_wake.name: Wake
w_wake.up: A revenant wisp that perishes mends 2% of your life.

a_sage.name: The Aether-Sage
a_sage.up: Soul Swarm, Needle and Thread and Spool jump on to 2 more creatures, at 60%.
a_sage.rev: Nothing jumps. Soul Swarm becomes a thread that drains its creature's life into yours for 3 s, and Needle and Thread and Spool mend you for 20% of what they deal.

a_blade.name: The Hollow Blade
a_blade.up: Needle and Thread leaves a smouldering seam along its line for 1.5 s. What stands in it burns.
a_blade.rev: Melee: Needle and Thread becomes a spirit sword. Hold to swing it in wide arcs.

a_pyre.name: Pyre
a_pyre.up: Soul Storm's souls and Spool's shards set creatures burning.
a_pyre.rev: Wraith Form leaves a trail of pale fire behind you.

a_rebuke.name: The Rebuke
a_rebuke.up: Soul Leash cracks like a whip every second: everything touching the rope is struck and thrown back.
a_rebuke.rev: Soul Leash flies as a harpoon: it strikes hard and pins its creature where it stands.

g_ward.name: Deep Veil
g_ward.up: The Veil soaks 5% more of every blow.

g_mark.name: Branding Mark
g_mark.up: Needle's Mark lasts twice as long.

g_orb.name: Heavy Spool
g_orb.up: Spool flies slower and lasts 50% longer.

g_swarm.name: Soul Hunger
g_swarm.up: Souls strike once more before they fade.

g_wraith.name: Wraith Step
g_wraith.up: Leaving Wraith Form lets loose 6 souls.

a_revenant.name: The Revenant
a_revenant.up: A revenant wisp that perishes comes back at once, armoured in bone: for 5 s nothing it strikes can end it.

a_hunger.name: The Hungering Aether
a_hunger.up: Soul Swarm's souls steal a little life with every strike.

z_bloom.name: The Bloom
z_bloom.up: Miasmic Exhalation leaves a ring of miasma clouds where it ends, even without the ring of clouds, and its clouds last longer.
z_bloom.rev: Ranged: Miasmic Exhalation erupts at the cursor instead of around you.

z_tide.name: The Tide
z_tide.up: Miasma Tide splits into three walls in a fan.
z_tide.rev: Melee: Miasma Tide whirls around you as a ring of cutting miasma for 2 s instead of rolling forward.

z_venom.name: The Coil
z_venom.up: Venom Claws miasma stacks up to five times, and each stack slows harder.
z_venom.rev: Ranged: while Venom Claws lasts, your weapon attacks throw three venom knives instead of cutting.

z_plague.name: The Plague-Bearer
z_plague.up: You leave a trail of miasma clouds wherever you walk.
z_plague.rev: Your cloud drinks instead of sickening: every enemy in it feeds you a little of its life.

zm_fang.name: Barbed Knives
zm_fang.up: Venom knives and needles pass through one more enemy.

zm_breath.name: Held Breath
zm_breath.up: Exhale keeps a quarter of the Miasma it spends, and Inhale draws in clouds from twice as far.

zm_carrion.name: Carrion Flowers
zm_carrion.up: Sickened enemies that die leave a cloud 15% more often.

zm_contag.name: Wider Contagion
zm_contag.up: Contagion leaps to one more enemy each time.

z_mirror.name: The Mirror
z_mirror.up: Blur leaves two decoys instead of one.
z_mirror.rev: Melee: Blur steps into the enemy nearest the cursor and strikes it, gaining an Omen. The decoy stays where you stood.

z_hanged.name: The Hanged Man
z_hanged.up: Enemies that wander into Haze hang in the air: held for 1.5 s before the madness takes them.
z_hanged.rev: Haze becomes a mantle on you for 6 s: anything that comes close is confused.

z_trapq.name: The Trapper-Queen
z_trapq.up: Traps arm the moment they land, and you can have two more out.
z_trapq.rev: Traps are worn, not thrown. Each time you are struck, a worn trap springs at your feet.

zd_needle.name: Twin Needles
zd_needle.up: Needle Sentries fire two needles at a time.

zd_snare.name: Heavy Smoke
zd_snare.up: Miasma Wake smokes 50% longer and its waves hit a quarter harder.

zd_mine.name: Chain Spores
zd_mine.up: Sighing Bladder bursts a second time.

zd_lure.name: Siren Song
zd_lure.up: Siren Lure confuses what it drags.

zd_mirage.name: Warped Flesh
zd_mirage.up: Enemies in Mirage take 15% more damage.

z_reaper.name: The Reaper
z_reaper.up: A finisher that kills keeps its Omens.
z_reaper.rev: Ranged: Reap is thrown. A spectral scythe flies out and back, spending your Omens on everything it cuts.

z_grave.name: The Grave
z_grave.up: Grave Strike, Hanged Man's Heel and Reap root what they hit for a second.
z_grave.rev: Your cloud turns to grave-dust: it stops sickening, but everything in it is slowed hard and takes 15% more damage.

z_death.name: Death
z_death.up: Every kill, by any means, gives an Omen.
z_death.rev: Omens never fade, but you can hold only two, and finishers strike for double.

zx_step.name: Death's Wake
zx_step.up: Death's Step leaves miasma clouds along its path.

zx_kiss.name: Iron Heel
zx_kiss.up: Hanged Man's Heel kicks one more time.

zx_knell.name: Long Knell
zx_knell.up: The Mourning Knell terrifies for 1 s longer.

zx_breath.name: Grave Breath
zx_breath.up: Last Breath returns after 40 s instead of 60.

z_veiled.name: The Veiled Mother
z_veiled.up: Your cloud and your miasma clouds cloud minds: enemies in them are now and then confused.

z_widow.name: The Black Widow
z_widow.up: Kills made by a finisher spin a web of miasma: every enemy within 2.5 yd is held fast for 1.5 s.

h_step.name: Hollow Step
h_step.up: Your rolls leave a silent afterimage. Creatures within 3 yd of it stagger for half a breath.

h_quiet.name: Unheard
h_quiet.up: Creatures notice you at 70% of the usual range.

v_unwritten.name: The Unwritten
v_unwritten.up: Your kills leave no corpse and drop nothing, but each one refills 5% of your Essence.
v_unwritten.rev: You leave no trace: a creature that can't see you for 2 s loses you.

v_crown.name: The Choir Crown
v_crown.up: While you are above half life, every wisp you spend or lose comes back to the choir 3 s later. Each wisp in your choir drains 0.3% of your life a second.
v_crown.rev: Draughts don't heal you. Each wisp in your choir mends 0.3% of your life a second instead.

v_silence.name: The Last Silence
v_silence.up: Once in each place, a killing blow stops the world for 3 s and leaves you at 1 life.
v_silence.rev: Your skills make no light: creatures notice you at half the range.

v_unmade.name: The Unmade
v_unmade.up: One Major you hold counts upright and reversed at once (choose it on the board). You lose 25% of your maximum life.
v_unmade.rev: +1 to all your skills for each Major you hold (up to +4). You lose 25% of your maximum life.

kr_noon.name: The Noon That Falls
kr_noon.up: Fist-Of-High-Noon does not fall alone: two lesser fists follow on the nearest enemies around the first, at half strength.
kr_noon.rev: Melee: the fist is your own. Fist-Of-High-Noon comes down from your hand on the enemy in reach, at once and 60% harder.

kr_star.name: The Morning Star
kr_star.up: The breath sweeps back the way it came: a second pass of Morning-Star-Exhaled follows the first, at 60%.
kr_star.rev: The breath is drawn in, not out: Morning-Star-Exhaled drags what it burns 2 yd toward you and blinds it for half a second, but burns 30% less.

kr_sutra.name: The Burning Sutra
kr_sutra.up: Each talisman of Sutra-That-Seeks leaves a burning seal where it bursts, searing what stands on it for 3 s.
kr_sutra.rev: The halo is worn, not loosed: while Sutra-That-Seeks holds talismans, a blow struck on you in melee burns one away, and it bursts on the one who struck for double.

kr_ash.name: Ash in the Palms
kr_ash.up: When Hundred-Hands-Of-Morning ends, the ground where its target stood burns for 4 s.

kr_tears.name: Tears Without End
kr_tears.up: Tears-For-The-Living lets fall two more tears.

kr_brush.name: The Quick Brush
kr_brush.up: The halo of Sutra-That-Seeks regrows 30% faster.

kr_wax.name: Cooling Wax
kr_wax.up: Amber-That-Eats-Itself eats a third less of your life.

ka_spade.name: The Gravedigger
ka_spade.up: A shadow torn loose by Spade-That-Cuts-Shadows crawls to the nearest other enemy within 3 yd and pins it too.
ka_spade.rev: Ranged: the spade flings its cut as a black crescent. Spade-That-Cuts-Shadows flies 7 yd through everything, tearing the shadows of all it crosses, at 80%.

ka_palm.name: The Hungry Ghost
ka_palm.up: Palm-That-Is-Hungry eats what it gathers: an enemy dragged to your feet with less than 15% of its life is swallowed whole (not uniques or bosses).
ka_palm.rev: The palm casts out instead of drawing in: Palm-That-Is-Hungry throws everything in its reach out to the edge, stunned for 1 s, tearing at it as it goes.

ka_clap.name: The Unstruck Bell
ka_clap.up: The clap is answered: a second, wider ring of Clap-That-Ends-Speech follows 0.4 s later, at 60%.
ka_clap.rev: Clap-That-Ends-Speech makes no sound. It stuns nothing, but it unmakes every enemy missile within 6 yd, and what stands in the ring cannot strike for 4 s.

ka_bowl.name: Alms of Nothing
ka_bowl.up: Drinking from the Bowl-That-Holds-Nothing also runs 3% of the sand out of both bulbs for each thing it held.

ka_roots.name: The Starved Take Root
ka_roots.up: The roots of Spit-For-The-Starving stay 1 s longer.

ka_grip.name: Cold Fingers Below
ka_grip.up: Hand-From-Below holds its prey 1 s longer (bosses excepted).

ka_pitch.name: Pitch on the Soles
ka_pitch.up: Walks-Without-Feet pours a third less sand into the glass.

kd_finger.name: The Koan
kd_finger.up: The answer hardens: an enemy One-Finger-Truth strikes and does not kill turns to weeping stone for 2 s, and your next blow shatters it.
kd_finger.rev: Ranged: the finger points and does not touch. One-Finger-Truth strikes the first enemy in a 7 yd line, through armour, at 80%.

kd_mount.name: The Laughing Mountain
kd_mount.up: The mountain lands twice: after Mountain-Falls-Laughing you bounce 2 yd onward and fall again, at 60%.
kd_mount.rev: Mountain-Falls-Laughing does not leap: you drop where you stand, and the stone rolls out twice as far and stuns what it strikes.

kd_arms.name: The Thousand-Armed
kd_arms.up: The arms of Thousand-Arms-Of-Nothing strike all the way round you, not only in a cone.
kd_arms.rev: The arms of Thousand-Arms-Of-Nothing do not strike out. For 6 s they close around you as a shell: blows on you lose 40%, and an arm strikes back at whoever struck you in melee.

kd_bedrock.name: Bedrock Wakes Far
kd_bedrock.up: Step-That-Wakes-Bedrock raises four more spears at the end of its line.

kd_stone.name: Stone Patience
kd_stone.up: Grip-Of-Old-Stone holds its stone 1 s longer (bosses excepted).

kd_door.name: The Unmoving Door
kd_door.up: Once you have stood still for a second, blows on you lose 10%.

kh_lantern.name: The Black-Flame Lantern
kh_lantern.up: While you hold the sky (Halo-That-Turns or Gate-Without-A-Gate), each kill holds it 1 s longer, up to 10 s more.

kh_unraised.name: The Unraised
kh_unraised.up: What the Ossuary raises cannot stand before you: the raised dead take 20% more from you, and one that falls bursts into bone-dust that stuns those beside it for half a second.
